title: Anti-Taser petition prompted by death in Leduc gaining support
article: An online petition that calls for tighter restrictions on stun gun use is picking up steam.
The petition entitled, "Canadian Police: Don't Tase First, Ask Questions Later!" surfaced on ThePetitionSite.com on Aug. 5.
On Saturday, it had more than 1,800 signatures. By Sunday afternoon, that number had ballooned to 3,400 signatures. The target is 5,000.
The petition was made in response to the death of a 27-year-old man who was in a physical altercation with Leduc RCMP at a gas station at 50 Street and 50 Avenue in Leduc on Aug. 2.
Mounties were responding to multiple calls of assaults, car thefts and hit-and-run collisions in relation to the incident that ended in a man's arrest after police deployed a Taser.

It wasn't until the man was in custody that police realized he was in "medical distress." The man died in an Edmonton hospital on Aug. 4. The incident is now being investigated by the Alberta Serious Incident Response Team.
The man has been identified as Marc-Andre Fontaine - a father of three children who "he loved more than the world itself," according to a Facebook page set up in his memory.
